purpose: Preserve the hardened v2 learned-structure validation engine and its frozen protocol separately from the stale public pre-v2 main branch.

protocol_chronology.initial_protocol: FROZEN_PROTOCOL_v2.md contains the original development parent-cap set {4, 6}.
protocol_chronology.amendment: PROTOCOL_AMENDMENT_v2_1.md was frozen after prespecified development scoring and before generation of any confirmatory or latent-sensitivity observations; it changed the learned selector to L1 logistic conditional screening and evaluated caps 6, 8, 10.
protocol_chronology.confirmatory_lock: The amendment froze max_parents=10, screening_C=0.05 and local_model_C=0.7 before confirmatory observation generation.
protocol_chronology.preservation_rule: Both original documents are retained byte-for-byte. The apparent {4,6} versus {6,8,10} discrepancy is historical chronology, not silently normalized text.

frozen_confirmatory_estimator.local_model: logistic main effects plus all selected pairwise interactions
frozen_confirmatory_estimator.dense_baseline: HistGradientBoostingClassifier over all temporally admissible observed history

verification.required_check: all seven repository files must match the source_snapshot SHA-256 manifest and archived Python sources must compile
verification.status: pending GitHub Actions verification at the commit carrying this manifest

claim_boundary: This branch is a provenance archive. It does not itself promote new v3 results.
